candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders (fast, ~1-2ms), which the gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout. Traces show order 500s propagating to checkout 502s; order logs show repeated 500s on /v1/orders with healthy postgres readiness.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order (code defect vs config) not established; order traces/metrics excluded from context.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout correlate with order service 500s on POST /v1/orders in traces; order logs confirm repeated 500s with fast durations and healthy postgres readiness, ruling out latency/pool exhaustion. Deployment to order 2.0.0 is recorded but does not itself establish causation. Bounded candidate: order-side HTTP 500 fault.
missing_evidence: Order service traces for POST /v1/orders to identify the failing code path
Order service error logs/stack traces explaining the 500 cause
Order metrics for dependency operations (postgres/payment/inventory) outcomes
